comments.body: Since tidying up 4.4 to be much clearer, 4.10's topic of not allowing access control policy / metadata to be influenced by users is different than DOR. The idea of 4.10 is to avoid debug, cheat, or hidden admin flags, or to send access control parameters to the the user, and then trust them upon return. 4.4 is about DOR. If you disagree, please read the new 4.4 (great feedback), and if you still disagree re-open and let's tummy tussle. I wish it could happen over beers.
